title: Pegasus Co-Founder Urges Governments to Replace US AI With Sovereign Tech
summary:
Shalev Hulio, who helped launch the Pegasus spyware maker NSO Group, is calling on governments to stop relying on US AI providers and implement their own sovereign models instead. Hulio's new artificial intelligence startup, Dream, has developed a sovereign platform called Atlas that is already deployed in two countries.

Dream has raised more than $400 million and is currently valued at $3 billion. In a statement to the Financial Times, Hulio said that his history with the controversial surveillance firm provides an advantage in establishing trust with government clients.
